description.value: BjornBar Bakery is a boutique bakery café founded by Tamera Clark, best known for over 30 handcrafted dessert bars — from classic Nanaimo to adventurous Spumoni — all made in-house by hand. The Burquitlam location is one of three Metro Vancouver outposts and serves fresh pastries, savoury lunch items, specialty coffee, and their signature Ganookies (five-inch ganache-filled cookies). It's a sit-down café with a warm, carefully designed atmosphere that makes it a worthwhile stop for cyclists passing through Coquitlam.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 5m; rack at 23m; rack at 49m. Total: 2 spaces.
